records: Coinbase's USD22B average USDC held in products and USD8.616B period-end USDC AOP have different scope and time aggregation. No full reconciliation is published; do not treat their difference as an outflow or hidden balance.
Coinbase Q3 collateral disclosures do not name XRP. The aggregate other-crypto category may contain multiple assets; no XRP amount can be inferred, including zero.

Circle Arc launch participant lists and SBI founding-validator status do not establish every exchange or ecosystem participant is in production. Actual transaction volume, active counterparties, JPYSC usage and settlement share are unknown.

Circle Q2 mint/redemption flows are Circle Mint customer-initiated fiat conversions, not all USDC circulation changes, secondary-market transfers, cross-chain bridge activity or external capital flows.
Circle SBI Japan K.K. is 50/50 economically owned but Circle consolidates it as a VIE due control; no significant operating results were reported through 2026-06-30. Post-period activity is unknown.
SBI Holdings' approximately 9% Ripple stake is historical 2025 evidence, not a verified current cap table. SBIC East Japan is a distinct legal entity and must not be conflated with SBI Holdings.
